checks.description: A feature root holds ONE entity-named root, types/data/schema and the layer folders
checks.fix: move the file into its layer folder; a second root becomes a component or its own feature
move what both need up to src/app/ (helpers, tanstack-queries, components/UI)

checks.description: components/ holds one PascalCase component per .tsx file
checks.fix: rename to the component name (PascalCase.tsx); move non-component code to helpers/

checks.description: hooks/ and mutations/ files are use* hooks
checks.fix: name the file after the hook it exports (useX.ts)

checks.description: services/ and helpers/ are plain .ts (no JSX)
checks.fix: a file with JSX is a component: move it to components/
rename to *.test.ts(x), or move helpers next to the code they help

checks.description: Components are dumb: no effects, queries, mutations, HTTP, toasts or tracking
checks.fix: move the logic to the feature's hook (or mutation) and pass the result as props
create use<Action>Mutation in the feature's mutations/ and call it from the hook

checks.description: HTTP calls live only in services/
checks.fix: add one function per endpoint in services/ and call it from the hook or mutation

checks.description: No raw form or table controls outside the UI wrappers
checks.fix: use the UI kit component or its wrapper in src/app/components/UI/
one icon component per file in src/assets/svg/
